column4: `displayAdoptionStatus` checked `manifest.upstream.version` against the standards bundled *inside the running CLI* (`repoInfo.standards.version`). When the CLI itself was stale, that copy was older than npm — producing a backwards `⚠ Update available: 6.1.0 → 5.12.1` and structurally never able to say your standards were behind. This live bug was reproduced against vibeops (installed 6.1.0, an old global CLI bundling 5.12.1) before the fix. Now it feeds on `checkForUpdates(manifest.upstream.version)`: `available` = installed < npm latest. Message reframed (EN/zh-TW/zh-CN) to "your installed standards are behind" with the full two-step fix (`npm update -g` **and then** `uds update`); `--offline` skips silently.
